config_count: see exploration-registry.jsonl for every full-window replay
method: ALL results are full-window binary replays via canonical release CLI (portfolio_budget_replay) over the dev window with authoritative funding_rates_round12.db. NO fast screens.
structural_findings: Symmetric long+short (24 sleeves, no timing): all principal breach in 2023-2026 bull window.
long-only + stop_loss(strategy_drawdown_pct): ann collapses to ~0% (SL realizes permanent Martingale losses at 50% strategy DD).
partial-TP with breakeven-stage migration is the effective risk control: ann 50-93% with no breach, concentration 16-25% (<35%).
Wider spacing (150-250 bps) lowers trade count and DD; tighter spacing (60-100) raises ann but also DD.
Budget ladder: smaller budgets (1000/2000U) give HIGHER ann due to tighter per-strategy weight caps; no breach at any budget.
R4 regression reproduces audit exactly (34.81%/17.67%); its 49.6% concentration fails the 35% gate.

CYCLICAL RISK is the binding constraint: long-only profits in 2023-2024 bull (BTC +121% in 2024) but loses in 2025-2026 bear (BTC -6.4%/-15.9%). Direction-timed short by BTC ema200 survives 2025-2026 but blows up in 2023-2024 (whipsaw). No single fixed-param config passes 4/5 positive segments AND the DD gates.

target_verdict.aggressive_110_30DD_3of5: NOT HIT on segment count. ann 110% not reached (ceiling ~93% at DD 43%); DD<=30% reachable (29.9%) but only 3/5 positive segments.
target_verdict.balanced_90_20DD_4of5: NOT HIT. ann 90% requires DD ~43%; DD 20% only gives ann ~27%.
target_verdict.conservative_50_10DD_4of5: NOT HIT. DD cannot reach 10% at ann>=50%; best DD at ann~42% is 29.9%.
target_verdict.root_cause: The 2025-2026 crypto bear/chop window breaks long-only Martingale on 2 of 5 segments. Direction-timing to add shorts is whipsawed in the bull window. This is a regime-dependent structural limit, not a parameter-fitting gap.
